name: Final Embrace applies Cursed Form shapeshift helper 525047 (#10242)
contract: #10242 reported that Final Embrace (524865) is not recognized as a shapeshift form (GetShapeshiftForm() returns 0 instead of Cursed Form, breaking action bar paging and form conditions). All three effect slots of 524865 are occupied (transform 38508, +15% speed, Hematoma periodic trigger), while Ascension's hidden companion 525047 ('Final Embrace', rank 'Shapeshift SLS', SPELL_ATTR1_NO_AURA_ICON, SPELL_ATTR2_USE_SHAPESHIFT_BAR, DurationIndex 21, SPELL_AURA_MOD_SHAPESHIFT MiscValue 57 = SpellShapeshiftForm 57 'Cursed Form' with BonusActionBar 1 and creatureType 3 Demon) was never linked via spell_linked_spell. Expected: casting 524865 applies 525047 and changes creature_type from Humanoid (7) to Demon (3, which Unit::GetCreatureType derives solely from GetShapeshiftForm() == 57 for a Bloodmage), preserves the Blood Beast transform display (creature 38508), clears 525047 and returns creature_type to Humanoid (7) when 524865 ends, and drops 524865 if 525047 is removed.

steps.label: Let level scaling and login settle
CONTROL: Bloodmage starts as Humanoid (no shapeshift form)
CONTROL: shapeshift helper 525047 is absent before Final Embrace
DISCRIMINATING: shapeshift helper 525047 (Form 57) is linked and active
DISCRIMINATING: SpellShapeshiftForm 57 sets creature_type to Demon (3)
Final Embrace keeps its Blood Beast transform display (creature 38508)
Dropping Final Embrace removes shapeshift helper 525047
Dropping Final Embrace restores creature_type to Humanoid (7)
SETUP: Final Embrace and shapeshift helper reapply
Cancelling shapeshift helper 525047 drops Final Embrace 524865
